about: Owner decisions for docs/DMF-UI-SHADCN-PARITY.json. Each key is an item id from that record (an id ending in * covers every id with that prefix) and each value is the reason the difference is intentional. Keys starting with `measured.<property>:` cover a measured difference for a case or part id. A decision that no longer matches a difference fails `npm run shadcn:check`.

button.variants.size:md: Kept as an alias of default for existing consumers (DMF-UI-NOVA.md).
button.props.Button.as: Astro polymorphism: DMF UI renders <a> or <button> through `as` (and `href`) instead of Base UI's `render` prop.
button.measured.color:button/Button?variant=des: Destructive text mixes a fifth of the foreground into --destructive, keeping 4.5:1 on its tint where Nova's text-destructive gives about 4:1 (button-variants.ts).

kbd.measured.color:kbd/*: Kbd keeps foreground text: Nova's muted-foreground on bg-muted is about 4.4:1 in Neutral, below AA for its 12px text.

tabs.stateHooks:data-active: DMF UI styles the active trigger with data-[state=active]; the data-active custom variant (upstream/shadcn.css) matches it too, so Nova's classes apply as they are.

field.stateHooks:data-checked: Field styles a checked choice with has-[[data-checked],:checked], which covers native inputs as well as data-checked.
field.props.Field.as: Astro polymorphism: DMF UI renders another element through `as`, where Base UI uses `render`.
field.props.FieldContent.as: Astro polymorphism: DMF UI renders another element through `as`, where Base UI uses `render`.
field.props.FieldDescription.as: Astro polymorphism: DMF UI renders another element through `as`, where Base UI uses `render`.
field.props.FieldSet.as: Astro polymorphism: DMF UI renders another element through `as`, where Base UI uses `render`.
field.props.FieldTitle.as: Astro polymorphism: DMF UI renders another element through `as`, where Base UI uses `render`.
field.props.FieldError.message: A single error string as a prop, alongside children; shadcn takes `errors` objects from a form library.

checkbox.stateHooks:data-checked: DMF UI's Checkbox is a native input, styled through :checked.
checkbox.stateHooks:aria-checked: A native checkbox exposes its checked state itself, so it carries no aria-checked.
checkbox.slots:checkbox-indicator: DMF UI's Checkbox is a native input that draws its mark with ::before, so there is no indicator element.
checkbox.props.Checkbox.indeterminate: Server-renders the mixed state; a small script sets the native input's indeterminate property. Base UI accepts the same prop through its spread.
checkbox.dataAttributes:data-indeterminate: Carries the indeterminate prop to the script that sets the native property.

button-group.slots:button-group-text: DMF UI marks ButtonGroupText with a data-slot so parents can style it; shadcn's renders through useRender without one.
button-group.props.ButtonGroup.as: Astro polymorphism: DMF UI renders another element through `as`, where Base UI uses `render`.
button-group.props.ButtonGroupText.as: Astro polymorphism: DMF UI renders another element through `as`, where Base UI uses `render`.
button-group.props.ButtonGroupSeparator.decorative: Chooses between role=separator and a presentational divider, as DMF UI's Separator does; Base UI's Separator always exposes role=separator.

input.props.Input.type: DMF UI passes `type` straight through as a native attribute; shadcn names it only to forward it to Base UI.

input-group.props.InputGroup.label: Names the group in one prop (aria-label on role=group); shadcn leaves naming to the consumer.

switch.props.Switch.defaultChecked: Base UI's Switch accepts this through its props spread; DMF UI names it because its runtime reads it.

toggle.slots:tooltip-trigger: An icon-only Toggle is its Tooltip's trigger, so the label shows on hover and focus.
toggle.props.Toggle.label: Required accessible name. DMF UI shows it as text or, for icon-only toggles, as the icon's tooltip, so the name never depends on the icon.
toggle.props.Toggle.icon: DMF UI's shared presentation model (label, icon-label, icon) keeps one accessible name across the three looks; shadcn composes children instead.
toggle.props.Toggle.presentation: DMF UI's shared presentation model (label, icon-label, icon) keeps one accessible name across the three looks; shadcn composes children instead.
toggle.props.Toggle.value: Identifies the toggle in toggle:change events and its group's values.
toggle.props.Toggle.defaultPressed: Base UI's Toggle accepts this through its props spread; DMF UI names it because its runtime and server render read it.
toggle.dataAttributes:data-default-pressed: Configuration or state the DMF Toggle runtime reads or sets.
toggle.dataAttributes:data-presentation: Configuration or state the DMF Toggle runtime reads or sets.

toggle.dataAttributes:data-value: Configuration or state the DMF Toggle runtime reads or sets.
toggle.dataAttributes:data-variant: Configuration or state the DMF Toggle runtime reads or sets.

toggle-group.variants.type:single: DMF UI keeps `type` (single or multiple), as Radix-based shadcn did; Base UI uses a boolean `multiple`. No existing prop is removed.
toggle-group.variants.type:multiple: DMF UI keeps `type` (single or multiple), as Radix-based shadcn did; Base UI uses a boolean `multiple`. No existing prop is removed.
toggle-group.props.ToggleGroup.type: DMF UI keeps `type` (single or multiple), as Radix-based shadcn did; Base UI uses a boolean `multiple`. No existing prop is removed.
toggle-group.props.ToggleGroup.items: Renders the items from data, the original DMF API. ToggleGroupItem children work as in shadcn.
toggle-group.props.ToggleGroup.label: Required group name (aria-label on role=group).
toggle-group.props.ToggleGroup.defaultValue: Base UI's Toggle accepts this through its props spread; DMF UI names it because its runtime and server render read it.
toggle-group.props.ToggleGroup.disabled: Base UI's Toggle accepts this through its props spread; DMF UI names it because its runtime and server render read it.
toggle-group.props.ToggleGroup.value: The value field of `items` entries, read as a prop by the extractor.
toggle-group.props.ToggleGroup.icon: DMF UI's shared presentation model (label, icon-label, icon) keeps one accessible name across the three looks; shadcn composes children instead.
toggle-group.props.ToggleGroup.presentation: DMF UI's shared presentation model (label, icon-label, icon) keeps one accessible name across the three looks; shadcn composes children instead.
toggle-group.props.ToggleGroupItem.label: Required accessible name. DMF UI shows it as text or, for icon-only toggles, as the icon's tooltip, so the name never depends on the icon.
toggle-group.props.ToggleGroupItem.icon: DMF UI's shared presentation model (label, icon-label, icon) keeps one accessible name across the three looks; shadcn composes children instead.
toggle-group.props.ToggleGroupItem.presentation: DMF UI's shared presentation model (label, icon-label, icon) keeps one accessible name across the three looks; shadcn composes children instead.
toggle-group.props.ToggleGroupItem.value: Identifies the item in the group's values; required, as Base UI's is.
toggle-group.props.ToggleGroupItem.defaultPressed: Base UI's Toggle accepts this through its props spread; DMF UI names it because its runtime and server render read it.
toggle-group.dataAttributes:data-presentation: Configuration or state the DMF Toggle runtime reads or sets.
toggle-group.dataAttributes:data-type: Tells the Toggle runtime whether the group allows one or several pressed items.
